dialogues.speaker: Msciwoj
dialogues.text: Could you step on it, just a little? The crew's in a hurry...

dialogues.speaker: Izbor
dialogues.text: Come now, there's no need to rush. As they say, more haste, less speed. If you work fast, you'll make mistakes.

dialogues.speaker: Izbor
dialogues.text: Besides, the harbor overseers are pretty laid-back... Not that they don't know when to crack the whip, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Izbor
dialogues.text: A carrot takes time to break through the surface of the soil. If I ever taught you anything, this would be it.

dialogues.speaker: Izbor
dialogues.text: There is no "come on," only a "come and focus on doing your work"! Remember to tighten all the screws. That way, we can save ourselves a future headache...
